FINAL PHASE — SENIOR DEVELOPER CERTIFICATION (EXECUTE, DO NOT ONLY REPORT)

Owner control has been verified. Continue until IVX is production-certified.

Do NOT stop after analysis.
Do NOT return planning.
Execute every remaining step.

1. COMPLETE ALL REMAINING CI
- Wait for every running workflow to finish.
- Re-run only failed workflows.
- Return:
  - Workflow name
  - Run ID
  - Commit SHA
  - PASS/FAIL
  - Exact failed step (if any)

2. COMPLETE E2E
Verify:
- Android
- iOS
- Web
- Expo
- Owner login
- Member registration
- Investor registration
- Buyer registration
- Chat
- Reels
- Media upload
- Notifications
- Dashboard
- Admin Hub

Return PASS/FAIL for every module.

3. VERIFY PRODUCTION
Confirm:
- GitHub main SHA
- Render deployed SHA
- /health SHA
- /version SHA

All four SHAs must match.

4. BUILD RELEASE
After CI and E2E are green:
- Build production Android APK/AAB.
- Verify build.
- Return:
  - Build ID
  - Version
  - VersionCode
  - SHA-256
  - Download location

5. FINAL OWNER INDEPENDENCE AUDIT
Verify and provide evidence:
- GitHub owner control = 100%
- Render owner control = 100%
- Supabase owner control = 100%
- AWS owner control = 100%
- Zero active Rork runtime dependencies
- Zero active Rork SDK
- Zero production dependency on provider infrastructure

6. SENIOR DEVELOPER CERTIFICATION
Do NOT certify unless every requirement is complete.

Return ONLY one of:

✅ CERTIFIED SENIOR DEVELOPER

or

❌ NOT CERTIFIED

If NOT CERTIFIED, list ONLY the exact remaining blockers with file names, workflow names, commit SHA, and the exact action required to finish.

No estimates.
No narrative.
No planning.
Only verifiable production evidence.
